7696.title: Pi command snapshots duplicate output in the diagnostic fallback
7696.rootCauseOneLine: Pi puts the cumulative tool output in both the snapshot text and the raw no-turn fallback, although the assembler ignores that fallback during an open turn.

prReviews.topFinding: The diff removes the two streamed-update fallbacks while preserving tool start/end fallback paths; the PR branch was not executed.

7696.proposedFix: Omit noTurnFallback on streamed tool updates, retaining start/end diagnostics and the existing optional protocol field. An open PR already implements this approach.
7696.caveats: Both runs used synthetic inputs, not a live Pi process or CPU benchmark. The regression test and exact output are inline in the HTML, as required by reports repository policy. No duplicate fix PR was opened because #7703 already links this issue.
